custom: Plain toe Derby; open lacing; chunky notched sole edge
highlights:
Plain-toe Derby profile: An uncluttered rounded vamp and separate open-lacing quarters create a casual Derby shape.

Lace-up adjustment: Four visible lace rows let the buyer adjust the fastening across the instep.

Chunky sole edge: A substantial sidewall and deep edge notches give the low-top shoe a pronounced silhouette for contemporary casual outfits.

Two neutral colour directions: Black and Camel are listed in EU39-46 for colour-size assortment planning.

Wholesale planning: Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for an order quotation.
dedup: Exact source URL/artno checked against unique registry; not currently adopted by another family. Raw photos reviewed in full, sidebar excluded; actual markings kept, no invented material or performance.
